en.headline: Four vehicles including three KMB buses collide on Tsing Kwai Highway
en.dek: The collision near Container Terminal 5 at about 11.42am on Monday closed some lanes; one bus driver reported back pain while the Transport Department advised drivers to use remaining lanes.
body: A collision involving four vehicles, including three KMB buses and a light goods vehicle, occurred on Tsing Kwai Highway towards the airport near Container Terminal 5 at about 11.42am on Monday.
One bus driver was reported to have felt back pain. The front of one bus was badly damaged with the windscreen broken.
The Transport Department said some lanes were closed because of the accident and drivers should use the remaining lanes. Traffic was busy at the scene.
Emergency services attended. No further injury figures have been released at this stage.

zh.headline: 青葵公路四車相撞包括三輛九巴 一名車長背痛
zh.dek: 周一上午約11時42分葵涌青葵公路往機場方向近五號貨櫃碼頭發生四車相撞，涉及三輛九巴，部分行車線封閉。
body: 周一上午約11時42分，葵涌青葵公路往機場方向近五號貨櫃碼頭發生四車相撞事故，涉及三輛九巴及一輛客貨車。
據報一名巴士車長感到背痛不適。其中一輛巴士車頭損毀嚴重，擋風玻璃爆裂。
運輸署表示，因意外部分行車線已封閉，駕駛人士只可使用餘下行車線，現場交通繁忙。
救援人員到場處理。現階段未有公布更多傷者數字。
